title: Normalize fourth batch of 10 legacy closed 1104 task records and retire schema debt
goal: Reconcile git-verified historical provenance (base_commit, implementation_commit, verified_commit, closed) and surviving Core scopes across the next 10 legacy .agents/tasks/done/T-*1104-1.json records (T-GEMIMODELSLIFECYCLE4T1104-1 through T-HTTPTRANS1104-1) and remove their 10 entries from tests/task_record_schema_debt.json (51 -> 41).
notes: Phase 1 normalizes T-GEMIMODELSLIFECYCLE4T1104-1, T-GEMIMODSA4T1104-1, T-GEMIMODSC4T1104-1, T-GEMIMODSCAN1104-1, T-GEMIMODTYPES1104-1, T-HARNESSBINS4T1104-1, T-HARNESSCATALOGNATIVE1104-1, T-HARNESSEXECPATHS4T1104-1, T-HTTPAGENTSWEB4T1104-1, and T-HTTPTRANS1104-1 in .agents/tasks/done/ and shrinks tests/task_record_schema_debt.json from 51 to 41 entries without touching T-STEP1* or active claims.

reuse.searched: tests/task_records.rs, tests/task_record_schema_debt.json, and .agents/tasks/done/T-*1104-1.json in Susi Core and susi-dev-workflow in Susi Commercial Apps
reuse.why: Normalized the 10 legacy closed task records directly to the existing susi.task_record/v1 schema enforced by tests/task_records.rs (using susi_paths::hex::encode) without altering test harness code.
